grundentwurf:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: complete cozy room environment concept for Evi, a monochrome pet game. Wide landscape aspect ratio approximately 1.84:1, designed to remain legible on a 320×174 game scene.
Input images: Image 1 is the APPROVED GARDEN STYLE reference. Match its unified fine black contour weight, warm restrained cozy mood, natural proportions, continuous grounded space and gentle perspective. Image 2 is the current ROOM LAYOUT reference only: keep the recognizable furniture types and approximate left/right organization, but replace the flat icon-like arrangement with the same natural environment illustration approach as Image 1. The character and user interface visible in Image 2 must NOT be drawn.
Primary request: design Evi's small, cozy living room as one coherent attractive interior with real depth. A slightly elevated viewer looks towards the back wall; slight side-wall returns and floorboards receding naturally create perspective, consistent vanishing point. The foreground floor must feel connected to the back of the room, leaving generous navigable room for a small pet to walk forward and backward.
Objects: a simple wooden window on the left back wall with a quiet glimpse of leafy garden outside (no weather symbols); a modest wooden sideboard under and a little forward of that window, with a SMALL tray of three candles on its top; on the right, a low simple wooden table with one potted leafy houseplant, and a modest wall shelf above with a few books and one small trailing plant. A simple oval woven rug lies naturally flat on the middle/foreground floor. A small pet food bowl with a tiny paw emblem sits near the right foreground. Keep these few familiar objects, don't fill the room with extra decor or extra furniture.
Spatial composition: back window and shelf are far away; cabinet and table are grounded at middle distance; rug and bowl are nearer the viewer. The rug's shape foreshortens naturally with the floor plane. Leave clear visible floor routes between window/sideboard, center rug, and right table/bowl so the pet can walk into depth and scale smoothly. Show actual space on the floor behind and beside furniture, rather than a row of flat items. All furniture is believable in relative size and uses the same perspective and line weight.
Style/medium: exactly the same beautiful restrained BLACK-AND-WHITE line illustration approach as the approved garden, naturally cozy and slightly more realistic than cartoon icons. Thin consistent outlines, simple grouped details that survive reduction to a small pixel screen, only a few short woodgrain lines, a quiet mostly plain wall, sparse grounding shadows. Pixel-friendly forms. Pure black and opaque white only, no colors, no gray shading, no dense dithering, no pencil texture. Not photorealistic, not an isometric dollhouse, not an architectural diagram.
Constraints: finished edge-to-edge room illustration, no UI frame, NO Evi or other pet, NO people, NO text or labels, no dimension arrows, no depth-zone markings, no watermark. No Christmas tree or seasonal decorations in this base proposal; those can later replace the existing shelf/table area. Do not add a sofa, bed, fireplace, TV, extra windows or doors. Calm, cozy, clean, unified composition, not an asset sheet.
mehr_raumtiefe:
Use case: precise-object-edit / composition.
Edit target: the supplied proposed Evi room.
Keep the exact same cozy monochrome illustration style, same thin uniform black lines, same window on the left with its quiet garden view, same left sideboard and three-candle tray, same right table and potted plant, same wall shelf with books and trailing plant, same oval woven rug and small paw food bowl. No new objects or character.
Change ONLY the spatial framing to give the pet MORE usable floor depth: the back-wall/floor junction should be at approximately 52% of the image height instead of the current 70%. Show more of the left and right side-wall returns and a gently elevated view of a larger floor area, with consistent perspective and clear routes between the furniture. Slightly reduce furniture in the frame proportionally so everything fits and stays coherent; bring the rug toward the viewer in the open foreground, keep the bowl at front right. Visible floor continues behind/beside the sideboard and table, and broad open floor connects the back to the front. The floor planks must show believable depth and consistent perspective. Window and shelf remain on the back wall. This should still be a small cozy room, not a huge hall.
Maintain the original approximately 1.84:1 landscape framing. Pure black outlines and white fills only; no gray, color, texture or dense shading, no labels, UI, text, character, zones or diagrams. Natural simple linework matching the approved garden.
